insights.one_liner: JPMorganChase is a global financial services giant with two finance internships in Amsterdam, but both postings appear to ask for Dutch.

culture.text: Describes itself as a global leader in financial services advising large corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors.
Its open roles here are two finance and accounting internships in Amsterdam.

open.text: Neither of its 2 open jobs here is marked as Dutch-free.
Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor under this name.
Its internships draw around 137 applicants each on LinkedIn on average, so competition is stiff.

growth.text: Leased a new office in Frisco, Texas, adding 100 new jobs there.
Launched a Michigan manufacturing platform with Ford and others with $3 billion in aspirational commitments.

worth_knowing.text: Still tops a ranking of big banks on AI, with its lead widening.
Its new Seattle tech leader says AI is changing what the bank looks for in engineers.
